parsed.name: Cytomat 自动化培养箱式微孔板存储系统
parsed.name_en: Cytomat automated incubator microplate storage system
parsed.description: Cytomat 是用于微孔板（如 MTP/深孔板）自动存取与培养的培养箱式存储设备，通常带有内部仓位/货架、对外传递工位与自动门机构，可在受控温度及气体环境（如 CO₂、O₂、湿度）下存放实验板，并通过内部搬运机构在存储位、等待位与对外暴露/传递位置之间转运，便于与机械臂或自动化产线联机进行细胞培养、反应孵育与样品暂存。
parsed.description_en: Cytomat is an incubator-style automated microplate storage system for storing and handling microplates (e.g., MTP/deep-well plates). It typically provides internal rack locations, an external transfer station, and an automated door mechanism, maintaining controlled incubation conditions (e.g., temperature, CO₂, O₂, humidity). An internal transport mechanism moves plates between storage, wait, and exposed/transfer positions for integration with robotic arms and automation workflows in cell culture, incubation steps, and plate staging.
